In figure $ABCDE$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{BE}?$

I. $\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE}$

II. $\overset{\to }{BC}-\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{DE}$

III. $\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE}$
question.worked_solution:
- For the $1$st expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE} & =(\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BA})+\overset{\to }{AE} \\  & =\overset{\to }{CA}+\overset{\to }{AE} \\  & =\overset{\to }{CE} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{BE}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

- For the $2$nd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BC}-\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{DE} & =(\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CD})+\overset{\to }{DE} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BD}+\overset{\to }{DE} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BE}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $3$rd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE} & =\overset{\to }{BE}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only".
